name: Operation Progress & Activity Feedback
changes: Makes Automation item Scan files show activity on the actual clicked item button instead of only changing the unrelated global Scan library control, with an inline scanning status while reconciliation runs.

Adds consistent busy feedback to other potentially noticeable user actions: item metadata refresh/remove, Automation configuration saves and media adds, Settings save/restore/cache cleanup, Diagnostics refresh/clear, and provider save/delete.
Uses indeterminate spinner/activity states only where the backend does not expose trustworthy percentage progress; existing real Manual Import percentage progress remains unchanged.
Repairs the stale static sidebar/About display that still showed v3.6.35 in the published v3.6.36 shell and adds release validation for visible version identity.
regression_guards: No download-engine, Newznab search/scoring, Smart Import transaction, Automation scheduler, or metadata API semantics are changed; this release is limited to browser-side activity feedback plus required version identity markers.

Existing browse/article skeleton loading, Discover loading surfaces, release-search modal loading, Update Center activity, and v3.6.35 Manual Import real progress remain on their accepted paths and are not replaced.
v3.6.36 restored Automation action wiring remains required, including wireReleaseSearchButtons and the accepted item Save/Refresh/Open/Remove/Scan helpers.
v3.6.32 target integrity/no-downgrade protection, v3.6.33 TV-edition compatibility, and v3.6.28-v3.6.31 SAB/download-control behavior remain unchanged except for required v3.6.37 identity markers.
